events.name: Vancouver Canucks at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Zeev Buium scored in his first game since being traded to Vancouver, Thatcher Demko stopped 25 of the 26 shots he faced and the Canucks beat the New Jersey Devils 2-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zeev Buium scores in his Canucks debut as Vancouver beats the Devils 2-1

headlines.description: — Dylan Guenther scored 42 seconds into overtime and the Utah Mammoth rallied to beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guenther scores in OT to complete Mammoth's 5-4 comeback win over reeling Penguins

headlines.description: — The Carolina Hurricanes have been able to reach first place in the Metropolitan Division without star defenseman Jaccob Slavin for most of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurricanes defenseman Jaccob Slavin returns to lineup after missing 29 games

headlines.description: — Quinn Hughes scored in his Minnesota debut and the Wild beat the Boston Bruins 6-2 on Sunday for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Quinn Hughes scores in Minnesota debut as Wild beat Bruins 6-2 for 4th straight win

headlines.description: — Jakub Dobes stopped 27 shots and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Edmonton Oilers 4-1 on Sunday night, preventing Leon Draisaitl from reaching 1,000 points.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jakub Dobes stops 27 shots in the Canadiens' 4-1 victory over the Oilers

headlines.description: — Noah Ostlund, Tage Thompson and Zach Benson all scored and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Seattle Kraken 3-1 on Sunday for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thompson, Ostlund, Benson score as Sabres beat Kraken 3-1 for 3rd straight win
